title: Scope agency monthly summaries to current ERP permissions
description: A customer-service user opens the existing agency service fee monthly summary and sees only customer evidence allowed by the current ERP role-menu grant and salesperson data scope. Recheck authenticated user and customer menu grant before reading source data; apply the scope to both group-key paging and row loading so totals and page counts cannot reveal hidden customers. Denied identity, revoked grant and empty scope fail closed; existing OperationLogMiddleware records reads. Reuse existing AgencyServiceFeeMonthlySummaryService and SalespersonDataScopeService; preserve original-currency separation and evidence-only meaning. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets or .env changes, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused unit tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Monthly summary GET rejects missing identity or customer menu grant before source reads and rechecks ERP permissions on every request.
Both grouping/count query and page-row query apply the same current-user customer scope; unauthorized customer filter yields no data, and counts, pages and amounts expose no other customer.
Focused tests cover privileged, scoped, denied, revoked, empty and mixed-currency cases, preserve evidence-only semantics, and pass safe Release build/test.
